HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   B. Say Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
